meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交、变基、搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用 Git 管理代码版本
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits, rebase, and search history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently use Git for version control

howto.what: 装好后，它会接管你的 git 操作：把多个文件改动按模块拆成多个小提交，自动套用仓库近期的提交风格；需要时用 rebase 整理历史；也能查某段代码是谁写的、什么时候加的。文件多时会强制拆成多个提交。
howto.when: 当你提到 commit、rebase、squash 等关键词，或说出提交改动、整理历史、查找某行代码何时/由谁添加等意图时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这次改的 8 个文件按模块拆成多个 commit
say.note: 它会先分析文件和风格，再分批提交。

say.text: 把最近三个提交 squash 成一个，并重写提交信息
say.note: 它会用交互式 rebase 自动合并。

say.text: 查一下这行代码是谁写的、哪个提交引入的
say.note: 会调用 blame 和 log -S 定位来源。

howto.what_en: Claude takes over git tasks: splits changes into atomic commits, follows the repo's commit style, rewrites history with rebase/squash/fixup, and finds who wrote or introduced code. It forces multiple commits when many files change.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention commit, rebase, squash, or ask to commit changes, rewrite history, or find when/who added a line.

say_en.text: Split these 8 changed files into commits by module.
say_en.note: It analyzes and commits in batches.

say_en.text: Squash the last three commits into one and rewrite the message.
Find who wrote this line and which commit introduced it.
